sqlGroup.select: select a.id AS id, a.model AS model, a.time AS time, a.temp AS temp, a.remark as remark, a.pressure as pressure, DATE_FORMAT(a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime from jml_press_line_production_detail a where a.press_line_production_id = #{pressLineProductionId} order by a.update_time desc
